QuestInfo.name: Experimental Failure
QuestInfo.0: Dr. Betty looks busy. Perhaps you can give her a hand?
QuestInfo.1: Dr. Betty needs replacement samples for an important experiment. Collect #b20 Surgeon Eye Tails#k from the Surgeon Eyes in the usual way. They live in Young Tree Forest.
QuestInfo.2: You gathered the samples in time for Dr. Betty's experiment. If only she paid this much attention to her daughter...\r\nGo back to see Grendel the Really Old.

0.0: Yes, what is it? I'm a little busy.\r\n#L0##bI'm here to assist you.#l\n#k
0.1: Hm. I suppose I can find something for you to do. I could use some extra samples for my experiments, in fact.

yes.0: I need about 20 Surgeon Eye Tails for my current project. You can get them for me, can't you?

no.0: If that's all, then leave me alone. I have work to do.

1.0: Do you have my samples?\r\n#L0##bI do. Now you should have time to spend with your daughter.#l\n#k
1.1: Whew. Thanks to you, I can finally wrap up my research.

yes.0: Thank you so, so much. I thought I would never be done! Now I can finally play with my daughter. How old is she now...? Oh, and I heard Grendel the Really Old is looking for you. \r\n#b(You finished your investigation. Return to Grendel the Really Old.)

item.0: Please hurry. My experiment is very time-sensitive!
